proposition: The R. al-Arbaʿīniyya was written at the instance of Sayyid Ḥusayn Akhlāṭī for his son Nūr al-Dīn, and Akhlāṭī is the same man Ibn Turka names as his main oral source in the K. al-Mafāḥiṣ.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka's own preface to the R. al-Arbaʿīniyya, as reported by Melvin-Koushki
mediation.note: the author's own account of the occasion
